cover.concept: A tall glass water tank in muted indigo outline, with a bright accent-orange horizontal line marking a target level partway up the glass. The water inside sits calm and well below that line, held back by a small mechanical valve fixed to the outside of the tank, its handle shown mid-turn as if closing off. Thin concentric ripples spread out from the valve's base as the water level just begins climbing toward the marked line.

inline.name: budget-limited-audit
inline.concept: A flat circular magnifying glass in bright accent orange hovering over a row of simple analog gauges mounted on a control panel rendered in muted indigo line work. Each gauge needle rests at a different angle; one gauge is noticeably duller and its needle sits frozen in place, brought into sharp, bright focus under the magnifying glass while the surrounding gauges fade slightly into the background.

inline.name: deliberate-reset
inline.concept: A simple geometric hand silhouette turning a large analog dial in muted indigo, its needle moving away from a faded, worn red-orange zone toward a small hand-placed marker further around the dial's face. A single flat wrench shape in bright accent orange rests on the surface beside the dial.
